claim: For a narrowly defined light Wi-Fi browsing workload that allows the display to exploit very low refresh rates, the 2026 Dell XPS 14 has the strongest inspected result at roughly 43 hours; that is not a universal real-world battery-life title.
scope: Specific non-OLED/low-refresh behavior and test method; local availability must be checked.

claim: No exact cross-lab winner can be named for general real-world use because mixed workload, brightness, refresh behavior, OS, background tasks and battery configuration change results dramatically; within one 150-nit continuous-web dataset, the M5 MacBook Pro reaches about 18 hours.
scope: Do not combine 43-hour light browsing and 12:19 mixed workload into one ranking.
